page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m16-vws.5xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by 20 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 92.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.6 GB per core. The instance includes a single NVIDIA T4 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage and relies on network-attached storage, operating with an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics are relatively low, with stress-ng single-core performance and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the weak and poor categories respectively. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by the stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core benchmarks. Memory bandwidth is stable, showing average performance for both cached and uncached operations, though Passmark memory scores are weak.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers a cost-efficient entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads by pairing a mid-range NVIDIA T4 GPU with a substantial 92 GB memory allocation. The main tradeoff is the lack of local storage, requiring external storage solutions, and the lower single-threaded CPU performance.

This hardware configuration is suited for workloads that benefit from GPU acceleration but do not require high single-core CPU performance. Suitable applications include entry-level machine learning inference, video transcoding, virtual workstations, and multi-threaded database operations.

It features 20 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, paired with 92.0 GB of system memory and a single NVIDIA T4 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage, relying instead on network-attached options supported by an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Performance benchmarks reveal weak single-core CPU and memory scores, but average multi-core and memory bandwidth capabilities. This resource profile makes the instance a cost-effective choice for multi-threaded workloads requiring GPU acceleration, such as virtual desktop infrastructure, media processing, and moderate machine learning inference, where high single-threaded CPU speed is not a critical requirement.
